format: Little endian; scores [32,32768] uint16 BF16 bits; indices [32,4096] int32
source: Preserved BF16 retrieval scores from the development PopKV/PG19 trace; same fixed replay used by the architectural studies
scope: Single fixed layer/query architectural replay; no model weights, corpus text or token IDs; no native long-context quality claim
expected_order: Selected indices sorted by token position; stable ranking is score descending, index ascending
selection_policy: Native exact K4096 over all scores; no forced-current token; architectural service replay
